notes.location: Ichnogenus Pentichnus discussion; P. pratti description and Fig. 44 caption
notes.supports: Vertical subconical structures with pentameral symmetry; penetration depth distinguishes shallow resting forms. Published examples are positive hyporelief; this negative cavity and section are an explicit illustrative architecture convention, not a copied preservation.

claim_scope: Illustrative sectional sediment block surrounding a deep five-sided subconical negative cavity. Wide pentagonal mouth narrows to a small pentagonal floor; one front sector of sediment removed to expose penetration. Remaining geometry carries the full five-sided architecture with the omitted sector explicitly illustrative. No tracemaker, certain behavior or excavated specimen claim.
